topic: Adjusting data upload script for new environment
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the technical process of uploading daily data. [me] provided a reference script (`upload_day_afa.sh`) and noted that it requires modifications because the new environment (implied to be 'German' or similar) uses different buckets/folders and a different URL method (`/report-v3` instead of `/report-jcd`). [p1] confirmed they would copy the script rather than modifying the original.
decisions: The data upload process will use a copied version of the reference script (e.g., `upload_day_de`)
The script must be updated to reflect new bucket/folder structures and the `/report-v3` endpoint.
action_items: [p1] to copy the provided data upload script.
